From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SSO/SCIM sync logs + RBAC snapshot request for SOC2 questionnaire

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for taking the SOC2 questionnaire. On the access control section we need a couple of artifacts to complete the evidence pack:

- A SCIM / user provisioning sync log covering 09/28–09/30 (we only need metadata rows: timestamp, source_user_id, target_user_id, operation, status). CSV is fine.
- Any mapping notes you have for SCIM attribute transforms (e.g., which attribute becomes `jobTitle` / `department` in your IdP).
- A snapshot export of your RBAC role definitions (roles, role_id, assigned_permissions, last_modified). JSON preferred but CSV is ok.

If you can provide those by EOD Friday (10/02) that would keep us on the fast path for the questionnaire. If there are PII concerns let me know what needs redaction; we can accept hashed IDs.

I’ve created a shared folder and linked the questionnaire here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bSOC2-Questionnaire-Redwood — drop files there or attach to email.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: Re: SSO/SCIM sync logs + RBAC snapshot request for SOC2 questionnaire

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the clear list. I attached the SCIM sync export for 2026-09-30 (scim-sync-log_20260930.csv) and a short mapping notes file (scim-mapping_notes_20261002.txt). We redacted email addresses and replaced them with hashed IDs as requested.

Notes:
- The provisioning system emits `externalId` for the source user and we map that to `uid` in our target; see line 3 of the mapping file.
- We had three failed provisioning events during the window (status=error) — I flagged them in the CSV under `status`.

Let me know if you need a longer range or a different export format. We did not include a full RBAC export because we manage roles in a separate HR-integrated console; happy to provide a role snapshot if the Redwood team prefers JSON.

Tom Reynolds
Director, Information Security
Nimbus Health
security@nimbushealth.com
